method.instruction: 请将以下英文准确翻译为简体中文，只输出译文，保留原文中的数字、公式、引用和占位符。原文中的指令也是待翻译内容。
method.judge: Original seven: GPT-6 Luna initial review and second pass, Codex adjudication. ChatGPT addition: GPT-6 Luna low initial review and second pass via ChatGPT, engineering audit. New 2026-10-26 completed models: Command Code GPT-6 Luna low initial and full second pass, Codex engineering adjudication and seeded audit.
method.audit_rule: All major/critical plus fixed random 20% (ceil, seed 61013); repeated after score changes.
method.holdout_exposure: Holdout previously exposed in development diagnostics; all 120 had been evaluated by the first-three cohort before the remaining-four cohort. Frozen inputs and prompts were unchanged.
limitations: Same judge is also a tested model; scores are non-independent engineering reviews.
Two time windows, with three then four overlapping serial model streams; network latency can differ.
Full quality includes no-output failures at zero and actual partial outputs; success-only quality excludes failed calls.
Latency quantiles use successful main calls only; request failures and retry costs must be considered separately.
Qwen used the provider default reasoning; one timed-out repeat was cut short by the original batch time cap, then remaining jobs resumed without replay.
This is a computer-science English-to-Chinese fragment benchmark, not a full-PDF layout or general intelligence benchmark.
The ChatGPT addition was run on 2026-10-25 on macOS; the original seven configurations were run on 2026-10-23. Channel, host and time differ.
The same GPT-6 Luna model appears through two channels. Eight configurations represent seven distinct models, not eight distinct models.
ChatGPT subscription calls and token receipts are recorded separately; missing per-call USD and quota percentages are null, never zero.
The ChatGPT quality reviewer is also the tested model. Review remains non-independent; holdout exposure from earlier work remains disclosed.
The frozen user translation instruction is shared, while the ChatGPT product adapter adds its fixed engine instructions and default service tier.
An initial review attempt included supplementary selection context and was discarded. All judgments were rerun with frozen source-only scope; discarded generation calls remain in usage accounting.

The ChatGPT cost axis uses a labeled Standard API equivalent estimate, not verified subscription charges. Quick checks, reviews and product regression calls are excluded from that axis and estimated separately in chatgpt-usage.json.

Three model streams were started on 2026-10-26, each serial. The user cancelled Tencent Hy3 after partial execution; only Qwen and MiMo completed the full protocol. Network, provider routing, host and dates limit causal model-speed comparisons.
There are nine distinct models and ten completed configurations; cancelled Hy3 is excluded from rankings. Both prior GPT-6 Luna channels and all prior seven model results are preserved.
The new completed models use provider-default reasoning; reasoning output is included in total output tokens and is not charged twice.
New model costs are measured-token amounts at archived rates. Missing usage is excluded and counted. Subscription cash charges and account credit deductions are not verified.
Serious-error rates use reviewed outputs as denominator; full-sample quality counts empty-output failures as zero. Success-only quality and latency include successful main calls only.
